name: Shrines and Temples of Nikko
description: Tucked among cedar forests in Nikkō, Tochigi Prefecture, this cluster of 103 buildings belongs to two Shinto shrines, Futarasan and Tōshō-gū, and the Buddhist temple Rinnō-ji. Tōshō-gū is the showpiece, linked to the Tokugawa shoguns and richly decorated. Nine structures are National Treasures, and the wooded mountain setting has been held sacred for centuries.
